discovery: The theory of cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmological structure
motivation: Inflation changed how physics frames the origin of the universe. Guth showed that a period of accelerated expansion driven by a scalar field solves the horizon, flatness and monopole problems. Linde made the idea viable with new and chaotic inflation, which turned it into a general framework rooted in particle theory. Mukhanov (with Chibisov) calculated that quantum fluctuations of the vacuum, stretched by inflation, seed all cosmic structure. This predicts a nearly scale-invariant, adiabatic, Gaussian spectrum with a small red tilt. COBE, WMAP and Planck confirmed these predictions with high precision, including the tilt n_s below one, which was predicted before it was measured. This is a rare case of an idea at the interface of quantum field theory and gravity making sharp, falsifiable predictions that were then verified. It set the research agenda of modern cosmology, including the continuing search for primordial gravitational waves.
